preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner to modify fee parameters via setBuyFeePercentages/setSellFeePercentages
Fee parameters (liquidityFeeonBuy, liquidityFeeonSell, burnFeeOnBuy, burnFeeOnSell) must be set to 0

exploit_hint: 1. Owner calls setBuyFeePercentages(0, 0, 0, 0) and setSellFeePercentages(0, 0, 0, 0) to set all fee parameters to zero. 2. Trigger a token transfer that involves fee collection (transfer to/from uniswapV2Pair). 3. The _takeLiquidity() function will attempt division by zero in the calculation: tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell), causing transaction revert and DOSing contract functionality. 4. Additionally, _getRate() may divide by zero if tSupply becomes 0 through token burns.
